note: Alliance: wears level60_phase0_rogue_combat_swords_alliance, the set without the Horde rewards
how: race_gear.py: Dwarf is Alliance, so it can't wear the Horde rewards of the preset's level60_phase0_rogue_combat_swords. It wears level60_phase0_rogue_combat_swords_alliance, the same set with those slots re-ranked at a Alliance race (bis_phase0.sh RANK_ONLY SLOTS), kept by the rule, without a sim. On it, Dwarf hit 10.7% against the 8% yellow cap: trading the 1% excess for bonus stats lost or tied at 2 SE (-0.52 ± 0.12), so the set is worn as it is.
